query:
SELECT
                p.resource_type,
                p.resource_pattern,
                p.action
            FROM user_project_roles upr
            JOIN roles r ON r.id = upr.role_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
            JOIN permissions p ON p.role_id = r.id
            WHERE upr.user_id = $1
              AND upr.project_id = $2
